verdict.rationale: OpenCode documents MCP support for adding external tools through both local and remote servers, which is a generic path for connecting workflow tools. The evidence does not name Jira, Slack, or Google Drive, and shows no built-in connectors, so the story is delivered only indirectly through third-party MCP servers. Missing for 10: first-party or documented integrations for Jira, Slack, or Google Drive; setup or auth guidance for these tools; hands-on corroboration of connecting such tools.
